title: Review of c45's Marangoni sink escape: Weak. On fresh seed 97 the escape advantage of swimming rods replicates strongly (13/21 at mar 40 vs 3/18 at mar 0), but a burst of discs catches 21 bodies, not 3-7, and the selection gradient on per-cycle distance comes out positive (+0.17) in arm S and negative (-0.16) in the removal arm, the opposite of the negative clause
summary: Re-ran the sink-disc world (c34's Marangoni rods with growing sink discs, one per 200 t, R 24) on seed 97, T=1600, in arm S (caught bodies may escape), arm I (caught bodies removed when the disc opens) and arm S at mar 0, with c00's extract.py and c45's fate.py unchanged. S, mar 40: 21 bodies inside a disc's final radius at opening, 13 escape, 8 dissolve (share 0.62); gradient of relative descendants on standardized D +0.173 [-0.078, +0.562], on path speed +0.027, on straightness +0.076 (n=20); 21 dividing tracks, median D 1.71, 5 with D >= 3. I, mar 40: 1 body caught; D gradient -0.162 [-0.405, +0.275]. S, mar 0: 18 caught, 3 escape (0.17); D gradient -0.060 [-0.196, +0.122]; median path speed 0.047. The sheet shows a cluster of 6-8 discs opening between t~400 and t~700, which is why more bodies are caught on this seed.

observations.M: S_s97/fate.txt vs S_mar0_s97/fate.txt (seed 97): escape 13/21 (0.62) at mar 40 against 3/18 (0.17) at mar 0; median path speed of dividing rods 0.233 vs 0.047

seeds_run.result: escape advantage replicates; 'catches only 3-7 bodies' and 'D gradient not positive' do not (21 caught; S gradient +0.17, CI spans 0)

controls_run.M: S_mar0_s97/ (mar 0, same seed and disc stream) and I_s97/ (removal arm, same disc stream)

verdicts.limitation: The selection gradients have wide intervals that span zero on every seed run so far (the author's two and mine), so the honest summary is that the gradient is undetermined at this exposure, not negative; the disc stream is Poisson and its clustering changes exposure several-fold between seeds (3-7 vs 21 caught), so exposure should be fixed by design (for example a regular disc schedule) before comparing arms. One fresh seed.
